EUP-4 PREP 2 — THE CRITERIA'S INSTRUMENTS (ECONOMICS_SIM_PRODUCTION_REBASE.md §5.32).
Measures only: no line grades a criterion. Arms: inherited (the run's w_ref and zone) and
re-derived (the declared pair, ESR-10).

emission is the tail subsidy.

EI-3 — ROW 5, THE WINDOW-EDGE STUFFER. On the baseline, a miner with a hashrate share mines
every round(100/share)-th block and lists bodies of its own there after the pool's, as many
as fit under the penalty-free weight, for one window (720 blocks) from the start of a
year: unenforced (no fee) or enforced (the relay floor), uniform (every own block) or edge (the
same bodies in the first own blocks). Measured over 2160 blocks from the start: the longest run of
M_r > 1.0 and M_r's mean over it; the fees paid in floors (one floor = the relay floor's fee
for one reference transaction at the start); the net gain against no stuffing (its payout
change less its fees, SKL).

EI-3 — ROW 5, EVERY MINER STUFFS (added after the registered run, on review). Every block's

every block in the volume window carries them: the ordinary 1-in/2-out at the block's depth. A
lighter valid shape would list more, since M_r counts transactions. Where M_r rests at the
span's end, its mean over the span, the longest run of M_r > 1.0, and every block's payout less
the bodies' fees against no stuffing (SKL).

EI-7 — MEDIAN PATH-DEPENDENCE. The inherited arm's 15/80/5 baseline with a demand blip, the
demand multiplied for a number of blocks from the start of a year. Registered: one volume
window (720). Added after the registered run: half the long-term window (50000), the
longest blip that cannot move a median over 100000 blocks; then, on review, doublings of
